title: O you hypocrites, O, you whited sepulchres, O you who present a smooth smiling face to the world while your soul within is a foul swamp of sin, how will it fare with you in that terrible day?
html_source:
Hypocrites had better watch out, because “that terrible day”, the last judgement, will throw you in purgatory or hell.

This just considers people that outwardly project a good image, but inside are truly bad, “a foul swamp of sin”.

http://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Dlr90NLDp-0
(This is the traditional Dies Irae Gregorian Chant, describing the “last judgement” or the “day of wrath” as the title translates)
